definitions.gloss: quality of work; result; execution; workmanship
definitions.explanation: How well something is made or done; the quality of the finished product or performance.

examples.japanese: {出来栄|できば}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満足|まんぞく}している→満足する：22617_manzokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm satisfied with how it turned out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出来栄|できば}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To judge the quality of the works.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧{出来栄|できば}え⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}した→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: It was completed with a result exceeding expectations.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {出来栄|できば}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to turn out well
- {出来栄|できば}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満足|まんぞく}する→満足する：22617_manzokusuru⟧: to be pleased with the result
- ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{出来栄|できば}え: splendid workmanship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}がり→仕上がり：07432_shiagari⟧: the finish, how something comes out at the end.
- ⟦{出来|でき}→出来：11763_deki⟧: result, how something turned out; everyday and neutral (⟦{出来|でき}→出来：11763_deki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧).
{出来栄|できば}え is used for crafts, artworks, dishes, and performances, usually in praise.

WRITING:
- Also written {出来映|できば}え.
